areas.label: Recover four genuine relative stack homes
areas.evidence: Original ASM places the halfword CpuSet fill source at SP+0x5D4, the BG control word at SP+0x5D8, and the two projection outputs at SP+0x5DC/+0x5E0. The former aggregate packed them at 0x5D2/0x5D4/0x5D8/0x5DC. Ordinary u16/u32/s32 locals after the remaining aggregate recover all four original relative homes and the initial BG word read/modify/write address form. The 25-byte state array remains intact and its aggregate extent rounds naturally to word alignment. No attributes, padding members, dummy entries or extra writes are added. An explicit alignment trial gave size 4736/frame 1536/heuristic 804 and was rejected. Original BG upper-half inheritance and the original 0x177 key-mask behavior remain unchanged.
